closed: The maximal present source-visible alphabet, including the optional puncture swap, is exactly an order-18 subgroup; the definitely implemented physical subgroup may be smaller.
Adding the source-labelled compiled cross shear reaches only order 54 and preserves the X polarization up to port swap.
Imported local Fourier operations without the cross shear reach the order-1152 imprimitive subgroup.
The full order-51840 Sp(4,F_3) appears only when both cross coupling and polarization-changing controls are admitted.
open: A Hamiltonian, measurement, deformation or transport rule that physically selects the compiled cross shear.
A source-native polarization-changing operation rather than an imported universal Clifford or passive chart change.
Leakage and held-out gate-word tests on a physical carrier.
killTest: Any claimed source-derived full Sp(4,F_3) closure fails if it requires Cross or F_i without an independently derived physical implementation.
reopenDatum: One carrier supplies a calibrated cross-coupling control and a calibrated polarization-changing control whose logical actions match Cross and F_i without universal recompilation.
